problem_title: Sign-alternation conjecture for the flat Bernoulli game coefficients

evidence.text:
We prove the adjacent-count inequality in Hetyei Conjecture 6.10 for every n>=12. After factorial normalization, a renewal sequence has negative increments from index 11 onward. Symmetric arrowhead matrices, weighted power inequalities and exact finite checks propagate the sign. The literal ordered-composition factorial count and every spectral, recurrence and limit bridge are proved in Lean.See full solutionHide full solutionWe prove the adjacent-count inequality in Hetyei Conjecture 6.10 for every n>=12.
